cover.hook: Instagram is testing 90 minute videos. Is your content ready?
cover.label: 5 social updates worth knowing right now

slides.headline: Instagram is testing [[longer videos]]
slides.sub: Features lets creators post videos up to 90 minutes. It began rolling out to select US creators on Oct 26.
slides.source: Instagram, via Social Media Today, Oct 26

slides.headline: Meta ads can now [[target each creative]]
slides.sub: Inside one ad set, advertisers can pick the age range and gender each image or video suits best. It launched Oct 19 for Marketing API partners.

slides.headline: Reels get a [[reference clip]] option
slides.sub: Overlay another Reel under 90 seconds on your camera view. Pause it, move it and record your response. iOS only for now.
slides.source: Meta, via Social Media Today, Oct 15

slides.headline: LinkedIn tests [[ad revenue for creators]]
slides.sub: Pre-roll ads would run on creator videos, with creators getting a share. Brands also get new Creator Marketplace filters.
slides.source: LinkedIn, via Social Media Today, Oct 15

slides.headline: more [[#holidayshopping]] content on TikTok
slides.sub: That is TikTok's month over month jump for September. Black Friday is under a month away.
slides.source: TikTok, via Social Media Today, Oct 20

take.headline: One long video, up to [[eight Reels]]
take.sub: Instagram's Clips as Reels links clips to the full video. Plan the long version first, then cut from it.

cta.headline: Comment [[UPDATE]] and I'll send you the full list
cta.sub: All five updates, with the sources, in one place.

stories.name: story-thu
stories.headline: Instagram does not [[throttle AI content]]
stories.sub: Adam Mosseri says reach is not cut just because a post is AI made. Ranking picks what you like, and it still makes mistakes.

stories.name: story-fri
stories.headline: Is your Black Friday content [[ready?]]
stories.context: TikTok says #holidayshopping content grew 263% in September.

stories.name: story-sat
stories.headline: Instagram Edits is heading to [[desktop]]
stories.sub: A live version is in testing with selected creators. More editing tools fit on one screen.

stories.name: story-sun
stories.headline: Meta's top Muse request: [[which ads work?]]
stories.sub: Meta says business owners most often ask its Muse AI agent which campaigns are working and which are not.
stories.source: Meta, via Social Media Today, Oct 18

stories.name: story-mon
stories.headline: Would you post a [[90 minute]] video?
stories.context: Instagram is testing Features, with videos up to 90 minutes.

stories.name: story-tue
stories.headline: LinkedIn adds [[digital business cards]]
stories.sub: Share your profile with a scannable card and design it your way. Rolling out globally over the coming months.
stories.source: LinkedIn, via Social Media Today, Oct 18

stories.name: story-wed
stories.headline: Long form is back, so [[plan it]]
stories.sub: Instagram is testing 90 minute videos. Start with one idea worth ten minutes, then cut it into Reels.
